notes: Hypothesis b) requires the cohomological map of every codimension-n correspondence from a proper smooth connected curve to have image in Im i*. The printed first source expression is punctuationally malformed and is retained literally.

The author explicitly qualifies the motivic gloss: Si on admet le yoga des motifs, justifiable par les``conjectures standard''. The added plus grand applies to morceau; the level-1 part of the motif realizing Coker i* is said to vanish.
The conclusion writes an algebraically trivial z as i*(z')+z'', with z' algebraically trivial and z'' a difference of fibres of a Q-cycle inducing the zero map.
The proof uses hypotheses a) and b) and prints (iv)Z=i(vZ), with i lacking a star. This agrees with the source and with H's explicit note; no star is supplied by mathematical expectation.
The conditional linear-map identity is the sole actual mathematical check recorded. The page's references to earlier statements were not independently imported or proved.
Section 3 begins a relative setup with X and Y proper smooth over a regular connected S and a morphism i:Y→X. No new theorem is complete on this page.
cetté and hypthèse are source spellings confirmed by crops. The unparsed first display and final z/Z overprint are retained instead of regularized.

The H global machine-ell note and emph/underline equivalence are credited throughout. Bold Q versus ordinary underlined Q is treated as house typography, not as a letter error. Clearly editorial H notes are not treated as authorial text.
Visible xx/x cells record cancellation strokes, not recovered old lexical x characters. In particular the old word after cetté is not reconstructed as même.

The final proof equalities form a line continuation of the proof paragraph; no additional display or paragraph is introduced. New paragraphs are supported at Sous ces conditions, Démonstration immédiate, and 3.

No diagram, drawing, independent textual marginal annotation, or inserted paragraph is present beyond the individually inventoried elements. Tiny pale scan speckles and the isolated lower-page hairline have no securely readable authorial content and were not converted into glyphs.

check_events.outcome: Conditional local linear-map check actually performed: write J for the cohomological map printed as i or i*, and A for the map printed as Z. Assuming precisely the properties invoked on this page, A has image in Im J and Jv restricts to the identity on Im J. For any u, Jv(Au)=Au, hence (A-JvA)(u)=0. If Z' realizes vA and pullback realizes J, the displayed Z''=Z-(i x id_C)^*(Z') therefore has zero induced map. This verifies the local algebraic step only; it does not establish the earlier hypothesis a), the algebraicity of v, the representation of algebraically trivial cycles, or the motif claim. No independent proof of those statements and no formal certificate were attempted.

brief_feedback: No substantive rule change suggested. For uneven handwritten underline endpoints, word-level scope can remain uncertain even after a tight crop; an in-place alternative is preferable to assuming grammatical emphasis. The protocol also benefits from distinguishing visible x-out cells from alleged recoverable old letters, as v04 already directs.
